state_machine.formation: exact complete 1/3/5-second three-bar FVG with middle-bar displacement and aligned aggressive flow
state_machine.polarity_flip: a later completed close through the FVG far edge
state_machine.entry_confirmation: first later lower-edge or consequent-encroachment retest that closes back in the inversion direction
state_machine.entry: next exact complete bar's first executable Bybit ask for long or bid for short
state_machine.stop: beyond the inverted zone or retest extreme plus fixed buffer
state_machine.target: opposing pre-formation 120-second external liquidity that remains unswept through entry
state_machine.ordinary_exit: protective stop, target, or completed IFVG invalidation
state_machine.sample_boundary: mark remaining position to terminal executable BBO without treating it as a strategy close

execution_and_account.top_winner_counterfactual: remove the largest 10 percent of positive 12bp event keys before rerouting the entire global-slot path

development_rule: Freeze no more than one fit survivor per bar duration before reading the development parquet. Use identical rules and gates.
prohibitions: no favorable fill inside an unobserved interval
no risk or leverage rescue of a negative underlying trade path
